# Fix issues with push notifications

If push notifications aren't coming through, check your account settings, app version, and device notification permissions.

Table of contents

If you or your child aren't getting expected push notifications from Bark, work through these steps:

1. Log in to the app.  
   ​If you're logged out, Bark can't send push notifications.
2. Verify your account's notification settings.  
   ​ [...] + Open your Settings app > tap Apps > tap Bark > tap Notifications > turn on notifications.
     + Swipe down from the top of the screen and turn off Do Not Disturb.
     + Open your Settings app and check your Digital Wellbeing settings.
     + Open your Settings app and double check your unused app settings.  
       ​
